intended_object: Derivability of a finite sequent Γ (a finite set of formulas) from a first-order theory T in a one-sided, Tait-style sequent calculus with cut. In other words, the proposition that some derivation T ⊢₂ Γ exists. This is read off the name, the `⊢₂!` notation and the module doc ("Different characterizations of proof").
